Dialog

Pop-up modal, commonly used for message prompts, message confirmations, or completing specific interactive operations within the current page,support component invoking.(Minimum version: 24.9.0)

Import

Currently, only manual import is supported, npm functionality is still in incubation.

"usingComponents": {
"maui-dialog": "../component/dialog/index"
}

Sample Code

Message Prompt

Used to prompt some messages, only containing a confirm button.

<maui-dialog message="Prompt message" show={{show}} bind:close="onClose" />

Prompt with title

<maui-dialog title="Title" message="Prompt message" show={{show}} bind:close="onClose" />

Message Confirmation

Used for confirming messages, including cancel and confirm buttons

<maui-dialog title="Title" message="Prompt message" show={{show}} show-cancel-button bind:close="onClose"/>

Customize button text

<maui-dialog title="Title" cancelButtonText="Customize Cancel" confirmButtonText="Customize Confirm" message="Prompt message" show={{show}} show-cancel-button bind:close="onClose" />

Customize button color

<maui-dialog title="Title" confirmButtonColor="red" cancelButtonColor="blue" message="Prompt message" show={{show}} show-cancel-button bind:close="onClose" />

Custom Styles

Modify message style using messageStyle Modify title style using titleStyle

<maui-dialog message="Prompt message" messageStyle="color:orange" titleStyle="color:#F0F000" title="Title" show={{show}} show-cancel-button bind:close="onClose">

Modify overlay style using overlay-style

<maui-dialog title="Title" overlay-style="background-color:red" message="Prompt message" show={{show4}} show-cancel-button bind:close="onClose" />

Others

Use close-on-click-overlay to close dialog when clicking overlay

<maui-dialog message="Prompt message" show={{show}} bind:close="onClose" close-on-click-overlay />

Customize content using slots

<maui-dialog  title="Title" useSlot show={{show}} bind:close="onClose">
<view style="color:orange">Using slots</view>
<button>Customize button</button>
</maui-dialog>

Props

Parameter Description Type Default Value
show Whether to display the dialog Boolean -
title Title String -
titleStyle Title style String -
width Dialog width, default unit is px String/number -
message Text content String -
messageStyle Text content style String -
messageAlign Content alignment, options: left, right String center
zIndex z-index layer level Number 2000
customStyle Custom style String ''
showConfirmButton Whether to show confirm button Boolean true
showCancelButton Whether to show cancel button Boolean false
confirmButtonText Text for confirm button String Confirm
cancelButtonText Text for cancel button String Cancel
confirmButtonColor Font color for confirm button String red
cancelButtonColor Font color for cancel button String gray
overlay Whether to show overlay Boolean true
overlayStyle Custom overlay style String -
closeOnClickOverlay Whether to close dialog when clicking overlay Boolean false
use-slot Whether to use custom content slot Boolean false

Events

Event Name Description
bind:close Triggered when dialog is closed
bind:confirm Triggered when confirm button is clicked
bind:cancel Triggered when cancel button is clicked
